purpose: Compare supplied Heroes manuals with the pre-import catalog and record source-internal RPG issues. This is an evidence artifact, not an import bundle.

baseline.note: Every baselineValue is preserved from its research fragment. This report does not claim the local PostgreSQL database has been updated or that its values were independently queried.

applicationStatus.note: This report records research against the baseline; live application is tracked in CATALOG_STATUS.md. Edition differences, unresolved conflicts and ambiguous fills remain evidence.

summary.countingPolicy: Observations include repeated facts in different sources, class attributes repeated in hero tables, semantic text matches and documented inferences. They are not distinct entities or a count of verified PostgreSQL cells.

rpgSourceIssues.issue: Gnome prose says Direction Sense while the adjacent table says Danger Sense.
rpgSourceIssues.decision: Do not infer a starting-skill relationship.

rpgSourceIssues.issue: The Compendium prints Shadow Rogue armor class as 1t.

rpgSourceIssues.decision: Do not assert a normalized numeric reward.
